items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: Barbara Cox, I think. The girl that David married.

ctx.x: Who was the singer at that time, Barbara Cade?

Barbara Cox, I think. The girl that David married. She knocked Barbara out of the job and Boyd hired Ginnie. Ginnie was a better singer than Barbara; in terms of singing he made an improvement. I can't argue against that, what I didn't like was the way it was done.
David said that she always had trouble doing your tunes, you always kept her stretched out right to the limit.
